purpose: The daily brief is a CORE (written by the brief-writer, gated by the core rules) plus optional code-built MODULES. A module is self-contained: its own inputs, its own on/off flag, its own gate rules. A module that is off is skipped; one that fails shows a loud one-line degraded note and never blocks the rest (PM 2026-11-10).
insert_before: the macro section heading (§1); a module sits after the verdict block (§0, §0A, §0B) and before the macro section

modules.title: Sweep B (full-universe screens)
